pages.desc: Hand-applied Venetian and polished plaster for feature walls, fireplaces and media walls in Chichester and West Sussex. 10/10 on Checkatrade.
pages.body:
Specialist finish · Chichester

Venetian & polished plaster in Chichester

A hand-applied decorative finish with real depth and sheen, from a local team rated 10/10 on Checkatrade.

What Venetian plaster is

Venetian plaster is a polished, hand-applied finish built up in thin layers, giving a wall depth and a soft sheen that paint can't match. It is a genuine speciality of K&H and a finish few local decorators offer properly.

Where it works best

Feature walls, fireplaces and chimney breasts, and media walls behind a TV are the most popular places for it, in homes and in commercial spaces that want something distinctive.

Done by the person who quotes

With K&H you deal with Steve directly: the same person who quotes the job does the work. Every job is backed by Checkatrade's £1,000 guarantee.

Getting an estimate

Estimates are free. Send a photo of the wall through the chat on this page, or call Steve on 07908 701460.

pages.title: Listed Building Decorating, West Sussex | K&H
pages.desc: Careful painting, decorating and plastering for listed buildings and period properties across Chichester and West Sussex. 26 years' experience.
pages.body:
Listed & heritage

Decorating listed and period properties

Specialist care for listed buildings and older homes across Chichester and West Sussex.

Experience with older buildings

K&H has worked on listed buildings and heritage properties for years. Older homes need patience: careful preparation, repairs done sympathetically, and finishes suited to the building.

Repair before you paint

Much of the work on a period property is in the preparation: cutting back and repairing timber, filling, and making good before any colour goes on. It's the prep you don't see that makes the finish last.

Inside and out

Interior rooms, staircases and hallways as well as exterior doors, frames and woodwork, all finished neatly and left tidy.

Qualified and guaranteed

Steve is CITB and City & Guilds trained with 26 years in the trade, rated 10/10 from 225 Checkatrade reviews, and every job carries Checkatrade's £1,000 guarantee.

pages.body:
Plastering · Chichester

Plastering & skimming in Chichester

Re-skims, overboarding and ceiling repairs finished smooth and ready to decorate.

What we plaster

Full re-skims of walls and ceilings, overboarding, patch repairs and ceilings repaired after a leak, plus dry lining where it's needed.

Plastering and decorating in one job

Because K&H are decorators too, the room can be plastered and then painted by the same small team, with no waiting between trades.

Recent work

Recent jobs include a ceiling re-skim, a lounge plastered and decorated, and a ceiling repaired and repainted after a leak. You can see photos in the gallery.

Free estimates

Send photos through the chat or call Steve on 07908 701460 or 01243 778091.

Not sure if you're in range?

What we do in every area
